sentence: One panel study prices the threshold: the payoff to AI venture funding follows a U-shape whose turning point lies near USD 11.3 million, with short-term declines below that level and long-term gains above it
passage: [Banna & Alam (2025), sec. 4.1] "the turning point is observed at a log AI investment value of approximately 2.425 [ ] corresponding to approximately USD 11.3 million in AI-related venture funding. This suggests that firms investing below this level may face short term performance declines, while those exceeding this threshold begin to realise the long-term benefits of AI adoption"

gemini.note: The passage confirms the turning point at USD 11.3 million and explicitly describes the U-shaped performance curve with short-term declines below the threshold and long-term benefits above it.
